Class Animation

  • java.lang.Object
    • Animation
  • public class Animation
extends java.lang.Object
    The Animation Class is controlled by AnimationController. In some of my examples, you may find both baked together into a single class. The Animation Class is mostly a container for images, can be based on 1D or 2D array of images (for one-direction or multi-direction Animations) and also includes an enumerator for Direction to keep direction variables clean and manageable.
